name: Hokenshitsu no Sensei to Gothloli no Koui
original_name: 保健室のセンセーとゴスロリの校医
source:
"Perhaps I've been searching for a fresh start."
"Or maybe, just maybe, I've been searching for love."

Originally intending to serve only for the initial semester, Kazami Sora extended his role as the health counselor at Saika Girls' Academy into the subsequent term. 
Though his erstwhile travel companion, Shirobana, stays as his aide, their shared domicile at the hot spring inn, Shikisai Home, is now a chapter closed.
Having fulfilled the heartfelt task of guiding his sister to her final rest, Sora now walks a life shaped more by his own desires than by family obligations.
Perceiving this personal transition with intuitive understanding, Shirobana opts to step back, watching Sora from a respectful distance—much like his late sister Yuka once did.

As autumn arrives, the academy brims with a spectrum of educational activities—from experiential learning amidst lavender fields to an eagerly awaited festival in collaboration with sister schools.
Amidst this fast-paced tapestry of events, a novel enigma joins the seven school mysteries: whispered tales of an ogre haunting the nocturnal campus, allegedly laying waste to the school's surroundings. 
Convinced that a Tamabito may be the culprit, Sora assumes his Okuribito role to unravel this unsettling lore, aided by his reliable confidante and convivial drinking companion, the academy's in-house physician Otohime.

The poetic symbolism of cherry blossoms embodies an epitome of beauty,
And an essence of purity...

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://citrus-soft.net/product/hokeloli/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
「也許，我一直在尋找新的開始。」
「又或許，我尋找的其實是愛情。」

風見蒼空原本只打算在彩香女子學園任職一個學期，進入第二學期後，卻依然留在這裡擔任保健老師。
昔日旅伴白花仍是他的助手，兩人在溫泉旅館「四季彩之裡」的同居生活卻已結束。
親手將姊姊幸福地送往彼岸後，蒼空終於完成了長久以來的心願。此後，他將更多地為了自己的人生而活，而非肩負家人的責任。
白花比誰都明白他的變化，因此決定主動退開，從遠處守望著蒼空，就像他已故的姊姊夢歌曾經做過的那樣。

秋日到來，學園迎來了豐富多彩的活動，既有薰衣草田的校外體驗課程，也有令人期待的姊妹校聯合學園祭。
在忙碌的活動之間，一樁新的謎團加入了校園七大不可思議。傳聞夜晚的校園有鬼出沒，還會破壞學校周圍的環境。
蒼空懷疑此事與魂人有關，於是以送行人的身分展開調查。與他把酒言歡的可靠知己、學園校醫乙姬，也將助他解開這樁令人不安的怪談。

櫻花的花語，是出眾的美人，
也是，純潔……
